# graph-manager: specs API (list and read `docs/prd/*.md` of a workspace)

## What to build

Two read-only, login-protected routes in graph-manager's Fastify server that let the web UI watch a workspace's specs. `GET /api/workspaces/:id/specs` lists the `.md` files directly in `<workspace>/docs/prd/` (not `done/` or other subfolders), newest first, each with `{ path, name, title, mtimeMs, size }`. `GET /api/workspaces/:id/specs/file?path=docs/prd/x.md` returns `{ path, text, mtimeMs }` for one of them. The web UI (a later task) polls these every 2 s to open a floating spec pane when the agent writes a spec. Put them in a new route module `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/specs.ts` registered in `app.ts`.

Spec: `docs/prd/graph-manager-spec-view.md` (section "Server: specs API").

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/inspect.ts` (whole file, 73 lines) — the closest pattern: a route under `/api/workspaces/:id/…`, `resolveWorkspace(ctx.config.workspacesDir, req.params.id)` → 404 `{ error: "unknown workspace" }`, `stat`/`readdir` helpers, query params read with a `str()` guard.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts` (lines 34-41) — `insideWorkspace(ws, rel)`: rejects absolute paths and NUL, resolves symlinks with `realpathSync`, requires the real path to be inside the workspace's real root; returns `undefined` when the path does not exist.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` (lines 13-19, 80-89) — imports and the "feature routes (one line per feature)" block: add `await specRoutes(app, ctx);` after `inspectRoutes`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/auth.ts` — every `/api/` route already needs the session cookie via a global hook; nothing to add.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/inspect.test.ts` (lines 1-60) — test pattern: `appWithLogin()` from `../test-helpers.js`, workspace dir `path.join(ctx.config.workspacesDir, "github", "octo", "hello")` with id `github~octo~hello`, `git init`, `ctx.app.inject({ method, url, headers: { cookie: ctx.cookie } })`, symlink escape test.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts` — find `taskTitle` (exported, used by `pr.ts` `specTitle`): returns the first `# ` heading of a Markdown text; reuse it for `title`.

## Patterns to follow

```ts
// apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/inspect.ts:66-72
export async function inspectRoutes(app: FastifyInstance, ctx: AppContext): Promise<void> {
  app.get<{ Params: { id: string }; Querystring: { tasksDir?: string; spec?: string } }>("/api/workspaces/:id/inspect", async (req, reply) => {
    const ws = resolveWorkspace(ctx.config.workspacesDir, req.params.id);
    if (!ws) return reply.code(404).send({ error: "unknown workspace" });
    ...
  });
}
```

Errors are `reply.code(n).send({ error: "<lowercase message>" })`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/specs.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**
  - `export const SPECS_DIR = "docs/prd";` and `export const MAX_SPEC_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;`
  - `export interface SpecEntry { path: string; name: string; title: string; mtimeMs: number; size: number }`
  - `export async function listSpecs(ws: Workspace): Promise<SpecEntry[]>` — `readdir(<ws>/docs/prd, { withFileTypes: true })`; keep entries where `e.isFile()` (not symlinks: use `lstat` semantics — `withFileTypes` dirents of symlinks report `isSymbolicLink()`, skip those) and the name ends with `.md` (case-insensitive). For each: `stat` for `mtimeMs`/`size`; `title` = `taskTitle(first 64 KiB of the text)` or the name without `.md`. Sort by `mtimeMs` desc, then name. Missing folder (ENOENT/ENOTDIR) → `[]`. Also check that `<ws>/docs/prd` resolves (realpath) inside the workspace; if not → `[]`.
  - `export function specFileOf(ws: Workspace, rel: string): string | undefined` — valid only when `rel` uses `/` or the OS separator, normalizes (`path.posix.normalize(rel.replaceAll("\\", "/"))`) to `docs/prd/<name>.md` with exactly one segment after `docs/prd/` and no `..`; then `insideWorkspace(ws, rel)` must accept it. Return the absolute path or undefined.
  - `export async function specRoutes(app, ctx)`:
    - `GET /api/workspaces/:id/specs` → `{ specs: await listSpecs(ws) }`.
    - `GET /api/workspaces/:id/specs/file` with `?path=` → missing/invalid path: 400 `{ error: "path: must be a .md file in docs/prd/" }`. Use the syntactic check first; if the syntax is fine but the file does not exist → 404 `{ error: "spec not found" }`; if it exists but `insideWorkspace` rejects it (symlink escape) → 400 as above. Over `MAX_SPEC_BYTES` → 413 `{ error: "spec is larger than 1 MiB" }`. Else `{ path: <normalized rel>, text, mtimeMs }`.
    - Set `cache-control: no-store` on both (`reply.header("cache-control", "no-store")`).
- **IMPORTS**: `node:fs/promises` (`readdir`, `readFile`, `stat`, `realpath`, `open` if you read only the head), `node:path`, `FastifyInstance` type, `AppContext` type from `../app.js`, `{ resolveWorkspace, type Workspace } from "../workspaces.js"`, `{ insideWorkspace } from "./runs.js"`, `{ taskTitle } from "../runs.js"`.
- **GOTCHA**: `insideWorkspace` returns undefined for a missing file — distinguish "missing" (404) from "escapes" (400) by checking `existsSync(path.resolve(ws.path, rel))` first.
- **GOTCHA**: server code is ESM with `.js` import suffixes.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts`

- Import `{ specRoutes } from "./routes/specs.js"` and add `await specRoutes(app, ctx);` after `await inspectRoutes(app, ctx);`.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/specs.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** (pattern of `inspect.test.ts`): no login → 401; unknown workspace → 404; no `docs/prd` → `{ specs: [] }`; three specs with controlled mtimes (`utimes`) → newest first, `title` from `# ` heading, name fallback when no heading; `docs/prd/done/old.md`, `docs/prd/notes.txt` and a subfolder are not listed; a symlink `docs/prd/link.md` → outside file is not listed; file route returns text + mtimeMs; `?path=../../x.md`, `?path=docs/prd/done/old.md`, `?path=/etc/passwd`, `?path=docs/prd/notes.txt`, no path → 400; `?path=docs/prd/nope.md` → 404; a symlink escaping the workspace → 400; a 1 MiB + 1 byte spec → 413.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Both routes behave as above, with login required.
- [ ] Nothing outside `<workspace>/docs/prd/*.md` can be read through them.
- [ ] `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/specs.test.ts` passes.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/routes/specs.test.ts
```
